verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents creating tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira. Its planning flow lets teams pick options and mockups and then hand the plan off as one implementation task, which approximates turning a request into a scoped task. Nothing describes ingesting end-user feedback submissions or automatically structuring them into tasks with a proposed scope. Missing for 10: a dedicated feedback-intake or feedback-to-task conversion, documented auto-generated scope proposals from feedback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Create LightSprint tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira. Updates sync both ways
For larger features, plan first and align as a team. Pick options and mockups before anything is built, then hand the plan off as one implementation task.
